identification_evidence: The course folder is pbdatc. Its CBTSETUP.INI names the course: "Course Name=PowerBuilder: DataWindow Concepts".
The course title screen pbdatc/PD_1ST.DIB reads "PowerBuilder: DataWindow Concepts".

The yellow callout text in the image matches pbdatc/PD04.TXT line 321 ("Previewing the DataWindow enables you to see how using  edit styles has enhanced the presentation of the data."). Unit 4 of the course is "Displaying and validating data" (PD_UNIT.TXT, UNITLIST.INI), which matches the image title bar.
On screen: the sheet caption "DataWindow - (untitled)" and the DataWindow painter's StyleBar and preview contents.

version_evidence.finding: Neither the course files nor the image name a PowerBuilder version. Era evidence is strong: 1995 copyright, file dates Mar-Apr 1995, build stamp 13.06.95. The course predates PowerBuilder 5.0: the same catalogue lists separate, later courses titled "PB 5: DataWindow Concepts" (manual copyright 1996) and "PB5: DataWindow Construction Techniques". Its installer catalogue (pbdatc/SETUP.INI and pbdatc/UNITLIST.INI, dated 1995-06-28 and 1995-06-26) lists it beside "Moving from Powerbuilder 3.0a to 4.0". The course therefore most probably depicts PowerBuilder 4.0, but that is an inference, not a stated fact.
